crossRefs.note: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

translations.web: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”
translations.bsb: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?” “Twelve,” they answered.
translations.kjv: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
translations.asv: When I brake the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
